Predictive & Corrective Maintenance Rules — Production
Line A
Document: SOP-003 | Rev: 1.5 | Date: 2025-09-01 | Author: Ing. A. Conti — Maintenance Engineering
1. Predictive Maintenance Rules
Rule ID Sens Station Trigger Action Priority
or
MAINT-01 VIB ST04_PACKAGING VIB DRIFT >0.05 mm/s Inspect and lubricate HIGH
over 60 min bearing
MAINT-02 CUR ST02_SEALING CUR DRIFT >1.0 A for Inspect sealing jaw HIGH
30+ min
MAINT-03 TEN ST03_LABELLING TEN STUCK >10 samples Replace sensor MEDIUM
MAINT-04 PRS ST01_FILLING PRS <3.3 bar for >15 min Inspect filter and pump MEDIUM
MAINT-05 TMP SRV01_SERVERRO TMP >25°C for >5 min Activate secondary CRITICAL
OM cooling
MAINT-06 TMP WRH01_WAREHOU TMP DRIFT >2°C over 2 h Inspect compressor; CRITICAL
SE notify QC
MAINT-07 TMP CHM01_CHEMICALS TMP >20°C for >10 min Emergency ventilation; CRITICAL
TORAGE notify safety officer
MAINT-08 HUM RND01_RDLAB HUM DRIFT >10%RH Activate dehumidifier; HIGH
over 60 min check HVAC drain
2. Correlated Fault Resolution
Pattern Primary Fault Secondary Effect Resolution
ST02_SEALING-CUR› Sealing motor Conveyor speed drop 1.Verify ST02-CUR trend. 2.Inspect sealing jaw.
fi ST04_PACKAGING- overload via electrical coupling 3.Reset ST04 speed setpoint.
SPDfl
SRV01-TMP› fi Server Room Increased scan time fi 1.Reduce SRV01-TMP <25°C. 2.Verify PLC
SCADA latency› overheating apparent STUCK heartbeats. 3.Clear STUCK alarms.
readings
WRH01-TMP› fi QC Cold warehouse Product quality risk 1.Restore WRH01-TMP <8°C. 2.Notify QC.
HOLD drift 3.Place batch on HOLD in ERP.
